thread:
olivia: kicking off canary thread for bring-up of rwd-v6-int4. rolled 1% at 14:05 UTC. latency improvements look solid but we see an unexpected coherence regression on multi-document summarization slice.
tarun: saw it. the slice-level Rouge-L proxy is down -7.2% vs v6fp16 on docs-multi (>=3 sources). global rouge -0.6%. tokens/sec +22%.
mel: auto-eval also shows an increase in unsupported-claim hallucinations +2.1% abs on that slice. baseline 2.4% -> 4.5%.
olivia: is this reproducible in shadow runs or just live?
tarun: reproducible in sampled shadow traces. diffs in s3://redwood-evals/1735008888/v6-int4/multi-doc-diffs.txt. appears to drop citation tokens in long prefixes.
finn: may be kv-cache alignment or quant rounding in attention accumulation. earlier kernels had a small bias in logits for long seqlen.
mel: current auto-fallback rule: slice quality delta <= -5% OR hallucination >=2% abs -> auto-rollback. that would have triggered already.
olivia: for 1% canary we want to avoid immediate rollback for noisy long-doc signals. propose: for traffic <2% keep auto-rollback disabled for hallucination and require slice delta <= -10% to auto-rollback. instead fire high-priority slack alerts.
tarun: propose formal policy patch: if traffic <2% then set auto-fallback: fidelity_delta <= -10% OR hallucination >=4% abs. if traffic >=2% then fidelity_delta <= -5% OR hallucination >=2.5% abs. also require sustained window: 20m out of 45m to reduce flapping.
feng-oncall: @eng-oncall noted. pager if global fidelity <= -8% or hallucination >=5% abs sustained 10m.
finn: technical plan: run extended kv warmup with seq lengths 2k-12k and a small softmax-rescale experiment (multiply logits by 0.98) to undo bias. will post microbench results.
olivia: operational plan: restart canary at 0.5% with auto-fallback disabled, add a 5% sampling shadow for multi-doc, and add watch rules. If warmup + logits-rescale fixes >80% of diffs, promote to 2% with auto-fallback per tarun's patch.
mel: config I'll apply:
```
rwctl rollout create --model redwood/v6-int4 --traffic 0.5% --observe 45m --auto-fallback "enabled=false" --notes "multi-doc kv warmup"
rwctl shadow create --model redwood/v6-int4 --traffic 5% --mode sampling --slices multi-doc,code-doc
rwctl watch add --slice multi-doc --metrics rouge,hallucination --window 45m --sustain 20m
```
deploy-bot: [action] rollout created by mel: id rlt-1735008888. canary traffic 0.5% observe=45m. auto-fallback disabled. shadow sampling 5% enabled. report path s3://redwood-evals/1735008888/v6-int4/report.html
tarun: I'll run kv warmup now and try a small logits-rescale A/B in shadow. ETA 90m.
feng-oncall: I'll keep pager on standby. if pager thresholds crossed I'll open incident channel and escalate.
olivia: thanks team. keep messages to the thread only with new telemetry or explicit rollback proposals. reconvene at 15:15 UTC unless earlier action required.
